references.text: Balaam repeats the same declaration to Balak's messengers that he cannot go beyond the Lord's word, even for a house full of silver and gold.
Micaiah, another prophet, uses similar language about speaking only what the Lord says, refusing to say anything other than God's word.
Balaam confirms again that he can only speak what God puts in his mouth.
Balaam explains that he must be careful to speak only what the Lord puts in his mouth.
Balaam reminds Balak that he must do everything the Lord says.
Peter describes Balaam as one who loved unjust gain, which contrasts with his statement that he could not be bought.
Jude warns against those who follow Balaam's error for the sake of reward.
